qualification: Intel guest ACPI virtio-console discovery and Linux hvc0 binding

intel.command: make gate-x86_64-userspace SEL4_SDK_VERSION=2.3.0 with firmware/kernel pins retained in x86-virtio-firmware.json and the initrd pin below
scope: OVMF installs generated DSDT describing LNRO0005 with MMIO f0000000/4096 and GSI 16 level/high
Guest Linux mounts devtmpfs, opens and closes hvc0, then completes the PID 1 filesystem syscall roundtrip
VMM requires actual virtio-console DRIVER_OK status and a canonical serial-service wake before accepting success
No guest device command-line override, custom driver or host-device mapping is used

aml.result: PASS exit 0; generated DSDT disassembled and recompiled by ACPICA

diagnostic.result: Explicit guest failure at stage 2 (mkdir /dev); harness exited nonzero after the parked test QEMU was terminated. Final probe permits EEXIST but still requires devtmpfs mount and hvc0 open.

limitations: No frontend byte producer is configured: this proves discovery and binding, not Intel console TX/RX.
Canonical network/block, lifecycle reclamation, Debian parity, GUI integration and release qualification remain incomplete.
